tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta bzang po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/ rgya gar skad du/ ma hā san+dhimā yā bi shrān+ta s+ya bṛt+ti ra tha pha la nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta bzang po zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas byang chub chos sku dag pa las/ /mdzad pa'i rnam 'phrul sgyu ma'i sku bzhengs pa/ /'jig rten gsum mgon chos rje bla ma dang*/ /rgyal ba sras bcas gus pa'i gtsug gis mchod/ /gdul bya'i khams dang 'dul byed dbye ba las/ /theg pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med kun gyi/ /snying por gyur pa 'od gsal sgyu ma nyid/ /shing rta bzang po'i 'grel 'dis rab gsal bya/ /gang gi tshe thugs rje rmad du byung ba'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten du sgron ma rnam par bkod de/ ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal ba las/ zhing 'dir yang phyi dang nang gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das stong la sogs pas chos kyi phung po dpag tu med pa gsungs pa dag gi mchog ni/ theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i tshul rgya mtsho sgrogs pa las/ zab mo snying po gcig tu bsdus nas nyams su len pa la phyogs nges par sbyar na/ sgyu ma'i tshul rnam pa gnyis dpe brgyad kyis go rims nges pas rnal 'byor du gsungs te/ de'i man ngag gi gnad nges pa rnams rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs sgyu ma ngal gso zhes bya bar gtan la phab pa las/ 'dir yang de'i rnam par dbye ba don gyis 'grel pa'i gnad nges pa las/ re zhig dang po phyag gis mchod par brjod pa ni/ chos kun ma skyes mnyam pa'i ngang nyid las/ /ye shes sgyu ma gnyis med rol pa che/ /sems nyid rgyal po rang byung gdod ma la/ /ma skyes 'du 'bral med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni bstan bcos 'di'i rdo rje'i lus rnam par bzhag pa yin te/ so sor rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems khams bde bar gshegs pa'i

snying po ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi dbyings sam 'byung gnas dam pa yin te/ 'phags pa lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ thog ma med pa dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /'di yod pas na 'gro kun dang/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob pa yin/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di'i ngo bo ni rang bzhin gyi skye ba med pa dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ dngos po med pa dang*/ rtag chad las 'das pa'i phyir/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes smra bsam brjod pa las 'das pa so so rang gi rig pa don dam pa'i bden pa ste/ sgra gcan 'dzin gyi yum la bstod pa las kyang*/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam 'kha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di nyid gang gi ngo bor yang ma grub la/ 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhir gnas te/ do ha mdzod las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid kyang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar phyag gi rjes la bstan bcos brtsam par dam bca' ba ni/ rgyal bas chos kun sgyu ma'i tshul gnyis su/ /yang dag gsung de rang bzhin rtogs bya'i phyir/ /mdo brgyud man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus te/ /ji ltar nyams su myong bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /ces pa ste/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur gsungs te/ yum bar ma las rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa las ches lhag pa'i chos shig yod na de yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes pa dang/ sgyu ma mkhan rab tu bzang pos zhus pa'i mdo las kyang*/ bzang po chos rnams thams cad kun/

/sgyu ma lta bur shes par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la 'khor ba'i chos thams cad ni sems la snang zhing sems kyi bag chags mthu brtas pa'i phyir log rtog sgyu ma zhes bya'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ni ye shes la snang zhing rig pa'i rang mdangs sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba dang*/ lhun gyis grub la dngos po dang mtshan ma'i chos las 'das pa'i phyir yang dag sgyu ma zhes bya'o/ /ji skad du'ang sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po'i rgyud las/ /yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul gnyis su/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan med de/ /rnam par dag pa'i dbyings nyid tshul/ /ces so/ /de dag gis dang po bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i rgyu bstan zin to/ / da ni 'jug yul bstan bcos kyi lus nyid bshad pa la rdo rje'i gnas rnam pa brgyad las/ dang po chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur snang la rangabazhin med pas gtan la dbab par bya ba las/ gzhi snang la rang bzhin med pa gcig dang du ma'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos kyi dbyings dam par lta bas thag bcad pa ni/ gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur sems nyid nam mkha' che/ /stong gsal spros dang bral ba'i ngang nyid las/ /rgyal chos dri med nyi zla gza' skar bzhin/ /lhun grub sku gsum ye shes 'du 'bral med/ / ngang gis 'od gsal yon tan rdzogs par ldan/ /'di ni rang bzhin gdod ma'i gnas lugs te/ /gang dag gzhi yi sgyu ma lags par gsung/ /de la 'khor 'das kyi sgyu ma'i 'byung gzhi ni rig pa byang chub kyi sems ye nas 'od gsal ba bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po yin la/ de'i ngo bo stong pas nam mkha' lta bu/ rang bzhin gsal bas nyi zla lta bu/ thugs rje 'char gzhir gnas pas me long dngas pa'i ngos lta bu'o/ /de lta bu'i ngang nas sku dang ye shes kyi chos thams cad lhun grub ye shar chen po dbyings de'i yon tan du ye nas yod pa ni/ nam mkha'i dbyings na nyi zla gza' skar yod pa lta bu ste/

rig pa rang shar las/ dbyings de'i ngo bo ni nam mkha' lta bu'o/ rang bzhin ni ngang gi 'od gsal ba'o/ /thugs rje ni rigs pa'i snying por gnas te yon tan thams cad kyi 'char gzhi gyur pa'o zhes so/ /'di nyid 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'phro gzhi thog ma'i 'od gsal snying po yang dag dbyings kyi sgyu ma zhes bya'o/ /gzhi de lta bu la sems can du 'khrul tshul ni/ de nyid ngang las glo bur 'khrul pa'i sprin/ /rmi lam byed po gnyid kyi ngang tshul can/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig nyid dang ni/ /gnyis med gnyis su 'dzin pas bslad pa'i sems/ /kun du brtags pa'i ma rig las byung bas/ /'gro drug 'khrul snang sna tshogs rmi lam bzhin/ /de la skyes bu gnyid du song ste bde sdug gi rmi lam 'char ba yang 'char gzhi'i dbyings rig pa la rkyen gnyid du song bas byas dus/ bag chags kyi rmi lam du 'khrul nas med pa gsal snang gi snang ba la so sor spyod cing zhen pa ltar/ thog ma'i dbyings 'od gsal ba'i ngang las/ gzhi snang yul du shar dus/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas rang bsgribs te/ rang snang du ma shes pas/ kun brtags pa'i ma rig pas gnyis su bzung ba'i dbang gis dpyod byed gzugs 'dzin du mched pas 'gro drug so so'i 'khrul snang rmi lam dang 'dra bar shar te/ sems can tha ma ngan song gsum dang*/ 'bring 'dod pa'i lha mi gnyis dang*/ chen po gzugs dang gzugs med pa ltar 'khor ba ni/ 'phags pa yon tan rin po che sdud pa'i mdo las/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa/ /de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gzhi rig pa nyid/ gnyid dang 'dra ba'i ma rig pa kun tu rtog pa dang bcas pas myos pa'i dbang gis/ da lta 'khrul snang khams gsum gyi snang ba rmi lam ltar shar te/ gsang snying las/ e ma ho bde gshegs snying po las/ /rang gi rnam rtog las kyi sprul/

/sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /mi 'thun bde sdug myong bar 'gyur/ /ces so/ /de lta bu'i snang tshul ji ltar yin zhen/ med bzhin snang la bde sdug so sor myong*/ /yun ring dus nas goms pa 'di dag kun/ / gnas dang lus dang longs spyod la sogs pa/ /rang snang dge sdig las gyur bde sdug bsngal/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ri mo bris 'dra ba/ /gcig nyid 'khrul las mang por snang gyur te/ /du mar gzung las 'khrul snang rgyun mi chad/ / e ma srid pa'i rang bzhin rmi lam bzhin/ /'di ltar snang srid kyi chos thams cad med pa gsal snang la bden par zhen pa'i bag chags mthu brtas pas/ 'gro drug so so la rang rang gi gnas dang lus dang longs spyod dang bde sdug sna tshogs su snang ba ste/ de yang sems gcig nyid dge sdig gi las tha dad kyi byed pas 'khrul snang mang por snang ste/ snang ba la bdag tu bzung bas 'khor ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ni/ rmi lam lta bu'i las sna tshogs shes pas rmi lam ltar gyur pa'i snang ba las gzhan med de/ mdzangs blun las/ 'gro ba rmi lam lta bu ste/ /de bzhin las ni rmi lam bzhin/ /byed po nye bar len pa rnams/ /thams cad rmi lam 'dra ba yin/ /ces so/ /de lta bu'i 'khrul pa'i snang ba las don gzhan pa cung zad kyang med pa bstan pa ni/ rangabyung sems nyid gcig gi ngo bo la/ /ma rig gnyid kyis 'khrul snang gzung 'dzin blo/ /sna tshogs mang ldan rmi lam snang ba 'di/ /rang sems nyid las gzhan du ci yang med/ /log rtog sgyu ma nyid ces rgyal bas gsungs/ /rig pa gzung 'dzin gyi gnyid du dar cig log pa las/ 'gro drug gi rmi lam shar tsam las 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang ba'i bden pa pa'i chos phyi nang gang na'ang grub pa rdul tsam yang med/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /bag chags kyis ni 'khrul pa'i sems/ /don du rab tu snang ba 'byung/

/phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ /ces pa dang*/ phal po che las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum pa 'di dag ni sems tsam mo zhes so/ kha cig lung 'di la 'khrul nas snod bcud thams cad rang gi sems su 'dod pa ni lung 'di'i don ma yin te/ 'dis ni phyi rol gyi snang ba rang sems la snang ba tsam las don gzhan du ma grub ces gsungs pa dang*/ khams gsum po yang rang snang so so pa'i snang bar sems snang mthun pa tsam las/ don gzhan ma grub par bstan to/ /dgos pa ni nyan thos pa kha cig phyi rol bems po rang mtshan la sogs pa don gzhan bden par 'dod pa bkag pa la dgongs pa'o/ /gal te thams cad rang sems yin na/ gcig 'khrul pas kun 'khrul pa dang/ gcig grol pas kun grol ba dang/ 'gro ba ril shes rgyud gcig pa dang*/ skyes pa'am bud med lta bu gcig las mi srid pa dang*/ rang sems kyis yul rig cing 'jal ba ltar yul gyis sems 'jal par thal ba la sogs pa shing rta chen por bstan pa bzhin no/ /des na 'dir ni phyi rol dkar dmar du snang ba thams cad sems la snang ba tsam las/ sems dang sems las don gzhan bems po la sogs par grub pa ci yang med pas/ med bzhin snang ba'i rmi lam dang 'dra bar bstan pa yin no/ /mdor na sems kyi 'khrul snang thams cad log rtog sgyu ma zhes bya ste/ sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las/ sna tshogs rang sems snang ba kun/ / log rtog sgyu ma nyid ces brjod/ /ces gsungs so/ / de ltar 'khrul par snang dus nyid nas rang bzhin med pa'i dpe nye bar dgod pa ni/ ji ltar dha du ra yis myos pa la/ /snang ba sna tshogs snang yang 'khrul par gcig /de bzhin ma rig gnyid myaus las byung ba'i/ /'gro drug sems 'khrul ba la snang ba 'di/ /dben pa med ces de ring rtogs par bya/ /'ga' zhig dha du ra zos pa'i snang ba ni 'jig rten pas kyang bden med du byed pa ltar 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'di yang ma rig pa'i gnyid la byung ba tsam las/

bden pa med pa la snang bar ma 'gags pa tsam mo zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya ste/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ ji ltar bu mo gzhon nu'i rmi lam na/ /bu pho byung zhing shi ba de mthong nas/ / byung na dga' zhing shi na mi dga' ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes pa dang*/ khye'u rab snang gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang tshe sna tshogs chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma skyes pa/ /rmi lam bzhin du dngos med de/ /dngos po rnams dang bral ba yin/ /ces so/ /de ltar rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i chos rnams dang po'i gzhi la nam mkha' lta bur la bzla ba ni/ 'khrul snang 'khrul 'dzin 'khrul rtog las byung bas/ /bden med rdzun med gnyis med blo 'das zhes/ /nges par rang rig rang byung zhes bya ste/ /yin min yod min mtha' grol klong yangs su/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mkha' ltar shes par bya/ /'di ltar 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang thams cad 'khrul 'dzin gyi bag chags brtas pa las byung la/ de yang 'khrul rtog skad cig ma'i rgyun 'grel pa las byung ste/ phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa'i snang ba'i rtsa ba las dang nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa'i sems ni/ sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la thug pa'i gang du'ang ma grub pa'i phyir/ thog ma'i gzhi la byin pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ sa ni chu la chu rlung la/ /rlung ni nam mkha' la rab gnas/ /mkha' ni rlung dang chu dag dang/ /sa yi khams la gnas ma yin/ /de bzhin phungapo khams dbang rnams/ /las dang nyon mongs dag la brten/ /las dang nyon mongs tshul bzhin min/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ni/ /thams cad la yang gnas ma yin/ /ces so/ /de ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i 'khor ba ye nas dag mnyam nam mkha' lta bur bstan pa ni/ chos kun rang bzhin rmi lam lta bu

ste/ /snang dus nyid nas ngo bo 'ga' med la/ /rnam pa ma dor snang ba ma 'gags shing*/ /re zhig rdzun la rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /shin tu dpyad na bden min rdzun pa min/ /yod min med min rang bzhin mtha' las 'das/ /mkha' mnyam brjod 'das bsam yul rnams dang bral/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag par shes par bya/ /snang srid kyi chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar kun rdzob snang tsam du med pa gsal snang gi stong gzugs tsam mo/ /de yang don dam par bden rdzun dang yod med las 'das pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de nyid ma rig pas sems can thams cad kun snang med pa gsal snang la bden par zhen nas 'khrul snang la spyod kyang/ spyod pa'i dus nas chos nyid la g.yos pa cung zad med pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin las rol pa sna tshogs su shar ba zhes bya ste/ dkon mchog ta la la'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad bde par gshegs dang 'dra/ / byis pa'i blo can mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnams/ /'jig rten dag na med pa'i chos la spyod/ /lta ba rnam sbyong de yis shes par 'gyur/ /ces pa dang kun byed las/ 'di ltar snang srid snod bcud chos rnams kun/ /ma skyes kun byed nyid kyis don du rig /ces gsungs so/ /rmi lam yul med kyi rang bzhin gzhi ngo bo nyid kyi dag pa'i lta bar gtan la phab zin to/ / da ni snang la rang bzhin med pa'i lam rmi lam lta bu ni/ de ltar snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam dang 'dra lta bas thag bcad nas/ /sgom pas nyams su blang phyir bstan pa ni/ /bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung rab bcas nas/ /skyabs su 'gro dang byang chub sems bskyed de/ /chos kun mnyam rdzogs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /snang ba'i sgyu ma rab tu bsgom par bya/ /chos thams cad rmi lam ltar ngo bo nyid med par rtogs nas/ de'i don la mnyam par gzhag pa'i phyir/

yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la skyil mo krung du 'dug ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang/ sems can gyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ sna tshogs su snang ba'i chos thams cad ye nas ma skyes pa dang*/ gnas skabs su snang ba dang*/ snang dus nas bden pa med par mnyam pa ste/ thun mong du bden pa gnyis dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rten snod du snang ba gzhal yas khang dang*/ brten pa bcud kyi sems can lhar mnyam pa ste/ mnyam pa nyid bzhis chos thams cad kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa rmi lam dang 'dra bar bsgom pa ni/ gsang snyingalas/ mnyam gnyis lhag pa'i mnyam gnyis kyis/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bzang po'i zhing/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /de nas lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ spyi bor pad zla nyi ma'i dbus nyid du/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma dbyer med gsal btab la/ /mchod bstod rmi lam 'byong bar gsol ba gdab/ / bdag dang snang srid 'od zhu bla mar thim/ /mkha' mnyam ngang der dar cig glod la bsgom/ /de yis byin rlobs rtogs pa shugs las 'char/ /ranganyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og ma mu tig gi phreng ba dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ zhal 'dzum pa rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i dbus su hrīḥl yi ge drug pas bskor bar bsams la snod bcud thams cad thugs rje chen po'i sku dang gsung dbyangs su grags pas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: zhes brgya rtsa brjod nas/ spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i dbus su rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad thim zhing mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa'i 'khor sprin phung 'thibs pa tsam 'phro zhing 'du bar bsams la/

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib bshags/ /dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /dge bas byang chub che thob shog /ces pa lan gsum dang/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la 'dzab dbyangs dang bcas pas skyabs 'gro ci 'grub byas nas/ rmi lam 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgyu mar rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang stongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dzin zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i gsol ba btab nas/ snang srid thams cad bdag la 'dus/ bdag nyid 'od du yal te bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ /bla ma yang 'od du yal te nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i nam mkhas gar khyab stong gsal chos sku'i bla mar ngos bzung la nyams nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang der glod nas ji tsam gnas kyi bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /'di ni bsod nams mchog tu 'phags te/ yid bzhin bde ba mchog gi rgyud las/ bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /lha sku 'bum phrag bsgoms pa bas/ /gang gis skad cig yud tsam zhig /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan nyid du/ /bla ma dran pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sngon 'gro rdzogs nas chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu'i tengange 'dzin dngos la mnyam par gzhag pa ni/ de nas dngos gzhi ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ /phyi rol ri dang lung pa yul gru dang*/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' sems can sogs/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg ste yul lnga dang*/ /nangagi lus dang dbang shes chos rnams kun*/ /rmi lam nyid ces yang dang yang sgoms shig bden med kyi snang ba rang shar du rtsal sbyong pa ni/ phyogs mtho sa snang ba yang sar 'dug ste/ 'di ltar phyi rol yul lngas bsdus pa'i ri dang lung pa dang grong yul dang*/

sems can dang*/ nang gi lus dang*/ dbang po dang*/ dbang shes dang*/ dran rig gi kun tu rtog pa 'di thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba ste/ de bzhin du snang ba tsam las gang du'ang ma grub par 'dug /bden med du 'dug snyam du snying thag pa nas skad cig kyang ma yengs par bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du/ kha rtsang phan chad 'das pa'i chos rnams kun/ /mdang sum rmi lam dang 'dra yid kyi yul/ /de ring snang ba'ang med bzhin snang ba'i blo/ /mdang dang do nub rmi lam dang 'dra zhing*/ /sang dang sang nub ma 'ongs rmi lam ste/ /dgag sgrub bde sdug ci snang thams cad la/ /rmi lam yin pa'i 'du shes nyer bzhag nas/ /bden pa'i blo ni skad cig bsgom mi bya/ /'das pa'i chos thams cad kha rtsang gi snang ba dang mdang gi rmi lam lta bu/ da ltar gyi chos thams cad de ring gi snang ba dang do nub kyi rmi lam lta bu/ ma 'ongs pa'i chos thams cad sang gi snang ba dang sang nub kyi rmi lam lta bu/ ngo bo med pa snang ba ma 'gags pa/ med bzhin snang ba/ snang dus nyid nas ma grub pa ste/ dgag sgrub dang bde sdug thams cad rmi lam nyid las gzhan ma yin no snyam nas bden med du shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du/ 'gro 'dug za 'chag gtam smrar gyur pa na'ang*/ /rmi lam nang zhes ma yengs dran pas gzung*/ /ci snang ci byed ci bsam thams cad kun/ /rmi lam yin pa'i 'du shes ma bral bas/ /bden med 'al 'ol ban bun phyed phyod dang*/ /sang sing khral khrol 'dzin med chen por sbyong*/ /yul gang du 'gro yang*/ gnas gang du 'dug kyang*/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang*/ zas ci lta bu za yang*/ gtam ji ltar smra yang*/ rnam rtog ji lta bu 'phro yang*/ spyod lam ji lta bu byed kyang/ snang ba ji lta bu shar kyang/ skad cig de nyid du rmi lam dngos yin/ rmi lam gyi ngo bo bden med yin*/ bden med kyi ngo bo 'dzin med yin*/ 'dzin med kyi ngo bo 'al 'ol yin/

'al 'ol gyi ngo bo ban bun yin/ ban bon gyi ngo bo phyad phyod yin/ phyad phyod kyi ngo bo sang seng yin/ sang seng gyi ngo bo khral khrol yin/ thams cad med pa gsal snang yin snyam du ma yengs par 'dun pa rtse gcig gis sbyang bar bya'o/ /de ltar yul snang rmi lam du rtogs pas gzung ba rangabazhin med par ngang gis rtogs pa 'di ltar/ gzung yul 'khrul snang rmi lam nyid brtags pas/ gzung ba'i blo bral 'dzin pa shugs la bral/ yul bkag pas ni yul can 'gog pa yin/ de la gzung yul sna tshogs su snang ba'i chos rnams rmi lam du shes pa ni/ de la dang po rtogs pa'i blo gzung bar skyes pa yang rmi lam du shes te/ de'i rjes la spyod pa'i blo 'dzin pa'i rnam par byung ba de yang rmi lam du 'char bas/ gzung yul bden med du shes dus de la 'jal byed kyi gzung 'dzin bden med du 'char ba ni/ yul bkag stobs kyis yul can shugs la khegs pa yin no/ /de nas 'dzin pa log pas kyang gzung ba log pa'i tshul bshad pa ni/ res 'ga' snang ba rmi lam nyid 'jal ba'i/ /sems de phyi nang bar gsum rab btsal bas/ /ngo bo ngos gzung gza' gtad med pa'i blo/ /phyogs 'byams nam mkha' 'dra ba'i ngang nyid do/ /dran bsam tshol khro bral ba'i rig pa de/ /stong gsal spros dang bral ba ngang gis 'char/ 'dzin pa 'gags pas gzung ba rang 'gags pa/ /yul can log pas yul 'dzin grol ba'i tshe/ /snang yul 'brel med dpyad ra zhig par snang*/ /de tshe gnyis med rang byung ye shes yin/ gzung yul rmi lam du 'jal byed kyi sems la byung gnas 'gro gsum dang ngo bo ngos gzung brtags pas/ gang du'ang ma grub pa'i shes pa gtad yal stong par shar dus/ nang gi 'dzin pa rang grol bas/ phyi'i snang yul snang la 'dzin med stong pa'i rang snang ltar shar ba ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes rig pa byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ste/

gsang snying las/ sna tshogs snang la rang bzhin gsang*/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rab tu gsang*/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /de ltar shar dus na dgongs pa blo 'das gzung 'dzin dang bral te/ de ltar rtogs shing goms pa'i rang dus na/ /gzung 'dzin log pas yul sems zhen pa grol/ /snang la der 'dzin med pa'i nyams shar nas/ /gangasnang ye stong rtsa ba bral bar 'char/ /'di ni rang bzhin gdod ma'i gnas lugs yin/ /de la gzung 'dzin gzung yul la 'dzin pa'i rtog dpyod yin pas/ de gnyis dang bral ba ni gzung yul gyi zhen pa grol ba zhes bya'o/ /de'i tshe yul snang der 'dzin med pa'i nyams shar dus shar ba'i rig pa la bltas pas ye stong rtsa bral zang kar shar ba ni rang bzhin gdod ma'i gnas lugs chos nyid zad pas snang ba zhes bya ste/ pad+ma cod pan las/ zad pa'i snang ba yul rnams dang*/ /'dzin pa'i rtog pa kun las grol/ /rang gsal dag pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid/ /ces so/ /de ltar goms pa ji zhig na/ snang yul 'khrul pa dang*/ de la gzung 'dzin du rtog pa ma dag pa gzhan dbang nub nas dag pa gzhan dbang las gdod ma'i dbyings su rnam par grol ba yang 'di ltar/ rim gyis snang yul ma dag gzhan dbang yang*/ /der 'dzin log pas dag pa gzhan dbang du/ /ji zhig tshe na mngon du 'gyur ba ni/ /rmi lam 'khrul snang gnyid sad med pa bzhin/ /gdod ma'i gzhi la mngon par byang chub 'gyur/ /snang ba'i yul la der 'dzin log pa na/ bad kan can gyi mig ser log pas/ dung ser 'dzin gyi snang ba rang log pa ltar/ 'khrul snang cha dang bcas pa log pa ste/ ma dag pa gzhan dbang rmi lam dang gzung 'dzin zhen pa'i gnyid sad stobs kyis grol dus/ snang ba thams cad zhing khams dag par snang yang rang snang dag pa dung dkar 'dzinalta bu ste/ gzhan snang phyam chad pa med kyang phyi rol gyi snang ba la gzhan zhes brjod pa dang rjes su mthun par dag pa gzhan dbang mngon du gyur pa zhes bya'o/

/de'ang dag pa sa gsum du dbang bzhi 'byung ba lta bu ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yid dang 'dzin dang rnam par rtog /gyur phyir rnam par mi rtog dang*/ /zhing dang ye shes las dag la/ /dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yis gnas/ / dbang de mi g.yo la sogs pa'i/ /sa gsum la ni rnam bzhi ste/ /gcig la rnam gnyis de las gzhan/ /dbang ni re rer 'dod pa bzhin/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /de nas mngon par byang chub pa'i tshe chos kyi skur ro gcig pas/ snang mi snang thams cad las 'das pa'i dbyings las gzugs sku gnyis kyi snang ba lhun grub tu shar nas don mdzad do/ /de la 'khrul par snang dus nyid nas yod ma myong bar bstan pa ni/ 'khrul pa'ang sngon med phyis med par 'dir snang*/ snang yang snang ba'i dus nas yod ma myong*/ med bzhin snang ba bag chags 'khrul pa'i blo/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pas rmi lam 'dra/ / 'di ltar 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang thams cad thog ma'i dbyings na'ang med/ tha ma rnam par grol ba na'ang med/ da lta dbyings nas rang snang 'khrul ba'i dus kyi ngo kha la yod yod ltar snang yang/ snang dus nyid nas gcig dang du ma'i dngos po med pas/ med pa gsal snang tsam ste don la med pa sems la yod pa ltar snang ba'i phyir 'khrul snang zhes bya ste rmi lam bzhin no/ /ji ltar rmi lam dang mtshungs she na smras pa/ ji ltar rmi lam nang gi snang ba de/ /gnyid ma song dang sad dus med na yang*/ /gnyid dus snang la snang dus rang bzhin med/ /med snang gzhi rtsa bral bar shes par bya/ /dper na rmi lam du 'dod pa'i yul dang 'phrad pa'i snang ba de gnyid du 'gro kha dang sad dus gnyis na med kyang/ song dus snang ba ltar/ gzhi dang 'bras bu'i dus gnyis na med kyang*/ da lta lam dus na snang ste/ snang ba'i dus nyid nas 'khrul snang gzhi rtsa dngos med de stong pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam du shes par bya'o/ /ji skad du/ teng 'dzin rgyal po las/

ji ltar skye bu 'dod la chags pa dag /rmi lam na yang de yi yul mthong ste/ /nye bar brtan byed sad dus med pa ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rmi lam gyi ngo bo nyid rab tu goms par byed pa dag gi mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor bshad pa/ da lta nyin mor rab tu goms bya zhing/ /mtshan mo gnyid kyis rab tu snyoms pa'i tshe/ /bde ba'i mal du g.yas phab nyal ba ni/ /mgon po mya ngan 'das gzims lta bu la/ /rlung rgyu rab tu dal dang mig mi 'gul/ /snying nang a dkar shel gong 'od 'bar ba/ /tshon gang ches phra'i ngang la sems bzung la/ /rmi lam lta bu'i dran pa ma yengs bya/ /de yis rmi lam lta bu'i 'od gsal 'char/ /rmi lam ni nyin dus 'dun pa'i gnad las 'byongs pas/ seng ge'i nyal lugs kyis lhod chags par nyal ba'i tshe/ rlung gnad rab tu dal bas rgyu ba mi tshor ba tsam las mig har por mi 'gul zhing/ snying gi nang du a dkar po'i 'od 'bar ba'i 'phro 'du las tshon gang nas mthar shin tu phra ba rta rnga'i nyag tsam la sems bzung ste/ rmi lam yin snyam pa'i ngang la nyal bas/ ting nge 'dzin brtan pa rnams la dngas gsal mtha' dbus med pa'i 'od gsal du 'char mi brtan yang rmi lam sngon pas dngas te zin par sla'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pa las/ thog mar rmi lam 'jigs sngangs rmis pa na/ / rmi lam dran pas 'jigs snang rang sar grol/ /rmi lam ngang der ting 'dzin grub pa ni/ /rmi lam zin zhes rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /rmi lam du g.yang dang rbab dang khyi dang dgra la sogs pa'i rkyen drag po rmis pa de rmi lam du shes pa la dang po rmi lam zin pa 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ste/ 'jigs dngangs skrag pa'i sgrib pa las mchog gi rgyal ba'i gnyen po thob bo/ /rmi lam zin pa'i rjes/ de nas rmi lam bden med gcig tu sbyong*/ /de yang med bzhin snang ba'i 'khrul pa'i blo/

/rmi lam dang 'dra ngo bo ngos gzung med/ /bden rdzun blo las 'dus pa shes par bya/ /rmi lam zin nas skrag dngangs grol ba tsam gyis mi chog /thams cad bden med du shes dgos/ de'ang rmi lam 'di mi bden pa ltar chos thams cad med bzhin snang ba rmi lam lta bu yin nges snyam du bsam ste/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ 'jal dpal rmi lam ni snang la yod pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin du chos thams cad kyang snang la yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsung pa bzhin no/ /bden med du shes pa gal che bas/ sbyang ba ni/ de nas sprul zhing bsgyur ba'i rim pa yang*/ rmi lam dus der rang lus tshangs pa lha/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems sogs gang 'dod du/ /sprul zhing bsgoms la bden med ngang du gzhag /ranganyid sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ nyan rang dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ zhi khro la sogs par sprul te/ 'di kho na bden med yin pas de ltar snang ngo snyam du shes par bya'o/ /bsgyur ba ni/ de nas skad cig skad cig tsam nyid du/ /tshangs las brgya byin de bzhin lha las mi/ /gang 'dod bsgyur la bden med ngang du bsgom/ /sprul pa rnams phan tshun go bsgyur ba na bden med du 'dug snyam pas/ gang ltar 'dod pa ltar bsgyur ro/ /spel pa ni/ de nas brgya stong bye ba spel bya zhing*/ /gang 'dul thabs kyis gnyen por rtsal sbyang ngo*/ /sprul bsgyur gyi snang ba de dag brgya stong byed bar spel zhing*/ gcig tu gyur/ mang por gyur/ de kho nas bden med du sbyong zhing klu'i gnyen po rang nyid bya khyung dang*/ rgyal bsen la rta mgrin la sogs par gyur te za ba dang ldeng ba la sogs pas gdul bar bya'o/ /'di ni mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul 'grub pa'i thun mongs ma yin pa'i nye rgyu yin no/ /'di dag gi tshe lus 'chus pa dang 'khums pa dang 'phros pa byung na rtsa rlung 'chu bas/ sprul bsgyur la sogs mi 'byong ba'i phyir nyal lugs bde zhing rlung dal la rig pa dngas bar bya ba ni myong ba nges pa'i gnad do/

/bden med du sbyangs pa rdzogs pa'i rjes thogs/ de nas dag pa'i zhing dang yul khams dang*/ /'og min la sogs gang 'dod der song ste/ /bde gshegs blta dang gtsang ma'i chos rab mnyan/ /ye shes ting 'dzin gzugs sprin sgrub pa yang*/ /nyin mtshan rgyun du dran pas rab sbyangs pas/ /de ltar 'gyur ba rig pa'i yon tan te/ /gnad la mi bslu mngon du byed pa yin/ /'di ni yang zab snying po'i theg pa'o/ / sprul bsgyur 'byongs nas yul khams gzhan dang*/ lha klu'i gnas dang*/ gling gzhan dang*/ bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing khams sngon ma mthong ba blta bar 'dod na/ nyin dus 'dun pa btang la sngar bzhin nyal te/ yul khams dang 'jig rten thams cad mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na gsal ba stong gsum nyungs 'brur tshud pa'i rnam pa las ma yengs par nyal bas/ gang 'dod pa'i snang ba mthong ba ni/ rig pa la mtho rung gi yon tan ye nas yod pa'i gnad las byung ba'o/ /'di dag gi tshe'ang bden med kyi don la sbyang ba'i gnad yin/ bden med ni rang bzhin med pa yin te de nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin la/ de la slob pas yon tan thams cad 'grub pa'i phyir te/ sdud pa las/ chos rnams rang bzhin med pa yongs su rtog gyur pa//

'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes pa dang/ yum bar ma las/ rnam pa thams cad du lha dang mi'i las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams yongs su dag pa blta bar 'dod pas kyang/ shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nyungs 'bru gcig tu chud la nyungs 'bru de yang che bar ma sems/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyang chung bar mi mngon par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'di ni theg pa chen po'i mthar thug pa'i rnal 'byor du bya ba'i lam gyi snying po'o/ / da ni rmi lam goms pa las lam gyi 'bras bu bstan pa/ de ltar nyin mtshan rmi lam don bsgoms pas/ /dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gzeb las grol/ /ra ba ri dang rtsig par thogs med cing*/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes ting 'dzin grangs med 'grub/ /nyams rtogs tshad med 'phags pa'i ye shes skye/ /gnas skabs kyi ye shes 'bras bu ni thar pa'i lam sna zin nas 'dod dgu 'grub cing*/ mkha' 'gro grub pa can gyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ nad nyung ba dang zo mdog bde ba dang*/ tshogs kyi lam grub pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par ngang gi rtogs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin rnal 'byor du byed pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i lam thob pas rdzu 'phrul dang*/ mngon par shes pa du ma la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur rtogs pa la sogs pa'i rtags thob cing*/ dge ba brtan pa'i yon tan thob ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam lta bur lta la sogs/ / rtse mor phyin pa sbyor ba'i rtags/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed/ /'dzam bu gling gi skyi bo snyed/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge la sogs/ /nam langs du ni dper mdzad nas/ /bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni/

/rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de nyid ches cher goms pa las mthong lam dang sgom lam rnam par mi rtog pa 'phags pa'i ye shes gong ma rdzogs pa'i rjes ma mi slob pa'i lam mngon du byed do/ /mthar thug sems nyid gdod ma'i dbyings phyin nas/ /rang don chos sku gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis/ /rmi lam lta bur don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /de phyir rmi lam lta bu'i tshul sgoms shig /rmi lam lta bu'i byang chub kyi lam sbyangs pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu rmi lam ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sangs rgyas spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa yin te/ mdo las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu zhes so/ /de yang rang don chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings la lhun gyis grub pa'i thugs rjes gzhan don du gzugs sku nyi zla lta bur shar nas 'khor ba ji srid par don mdzad de/ rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang*/ /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*/ /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang/ /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang*/ /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang*/ /nges 'byung dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang*/ /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs pa ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mya ngan 'da' bar gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /ces gsungs so/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i ngang nyid las/ /rmi lam lta bur 'khrul pa'i 'khor ba pa/ /gang rnams sdug bsngal chu bzhi las grol te/

/bde chen yon tan 'byor ba'i gnas thob shog /sna tshogs rmi lam rnam kun stong pa'i gzugs/ /mtsho chen brgal dka' srid rtse'i bar khyab pa/ sdug bsngal me tshogs spungs pa'i 'khor ba las/ /ma lus 'gro kun bdag gis 'dren par shog /rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso las/ rmi lam lta bu'i le'u ste rdo rje'i gnas dang po'i 'grel pa'o// // de ltar chos thams cad rmi lam gyi ngo bo nyid du rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par bstan pa'i rjes la/ chos thams cad 'gag pa med pa sgyu ma'i rol pa tsam du rtogs par bya'o zhes bshad pa ni/ yang 'dir rgyal bas sgyu ma lta bu zhes/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gsungs pa/ /de yang mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i don/ /ji ltar nyams su myong bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /ji skad du/ yum bar ma las/ chos thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu ste/ rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa dang*/ mi 'gag pa dang*/ 'ong ba med pa'o zhes pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma 'dra/ /byang chub kyang ni sgyu ma bzhin/ /ces pa dang*/ ye shes rngam glog las/ sgyu ma chos rnams thams cad de/ /ming tsam ngo bo nyid kyis stong*/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mdo dang rgyud sde du ma las gsungs pa rnams 'dir bla ma'i man ngag gis legs par phye ba rang gi myong ba nges pa'i rtags gsum la bsten nas dbye na/ gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i sgyu ma gsum las/ dang po gzhi sgyu ma nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las 'khrul snang gi byung tshul bshad pa ni/ sems nyid gdod ma nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang*/ /lhun grub ye shes nyi zla gza' skar bzhin/ /ye 'byams rmad du byung ba'i dbyings rum nas/ /ma rig gzung 'dzin kun brtags rang shar bas/ khams gsum 'gro drug 'khrul snang sgyu ma bzhin/ /de'ang sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' lta bu ci yang ma grub pa'i ngang las/

rtsa ba srog 'dzin pa'i rlung lnga g.yos pa las/ rang snang 'od gsal du shar ba rang ngo ma shes pa'i cha las/ phyi nang gi snod bcud lus dang bcas par 'khrul te/ sgyu ma ltar sna tshogs su snang ba ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long gi rgyud las/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad gzhi ci yang ma yin pa las cir yang 'khrul lo zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /ji ltar sgyu ma ltar 'khrul zhe na bshad pa/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel stobs kyis rang snang ba/ /shing bu rde'u rig sngags tshogs pa las/ / mig 'phrul rta glang skyes pa bud med dang*/ /ri dang khang bzangs la sogs snang ba bzhin/ /sgyu ma'i rta glang la sogs snang ba'ang 'khrul gzhi'i rgyu shing bu rde'u nyid/ 'khrul rkyen rigs sngags kyis mig gi shes pa bslad dus/ 'khrul snang rta glang gi rnam par snang ba de yang rten 'brel tshogs pa'i rang snang las shar ba ltar/ 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang yang de dnga'adra ste/ ma rig dbang gis bag chags 'khrul ba'i blo/ /snang srid yul dang der 'dzin dug gsum shar/ /rang bzhin med la snang ba ma 'gag pa/ /sgyu ma'i skye bo 'dra ba 'di dag kun/ /bden med stong pa'i gzugs brnyan chen po ru/ /de ring nyid du nges par rtogs par bya/ /rgyu rig pa nyid/ rkyen ma rig pa yul du byas pa'i gzung 'dzin gyis bslad pas/ 'khrul snang snod bcud so so'i ngo kha la sna tshogs su snang ste/ dug gsum gyi 'khor ba mtho dman la spyod cing yod yod ltar snang dus 'di nyid nas/ don la rdzun snang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam las/ rig pa byang chub kyi sems su 'pho 'gyur med par rtogs par bya ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar skye bo mang po'i dbus dag tu/ /sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ /rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ /de dag mi bden sna tshogs snang ba ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/

/zhes so/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sgyu ma nam mkha' ltar bstan pa ni/ yong ye snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gshis la mkha' 'dra mnyam pa nyid/ /ma skyes gdod nas dag pa shes par bya/ / chos rnams thams cad gshis cir yang ma grub pas nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid de/ yum bar ma las/ chos thabs cad ni nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid de dbus dang mtha' mi dmigs so zhes pa dang/ teng nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ rgyal ba'i sras po dngos po rnam par 'jig /srid pa thams cad yang ye stong pa ste/ /nyi tshe'i stong pa mu stegs can rnams dang*/ /mkhas pa byis pa dag dang rtsod mi byed/ /ces so/ /de la kha cig chos de la mi ldan rnam bcad kyis stong la/ rang gi ngo bos mi stong par 'dod pa yod de nyi ma mun pas stong la 'od zer gyis mi stong zhes pa lta bu ni/ nyi tshe ba'i stong pa ste/ bden zhen las nam du'ang grol ba mi srid/ 'di ltar nyi ma rang gi ngo bo gcig dang du mas stong pas 'od zer stong ste/ stong la snang ba 'di ni dbu ma'i de kho na nyid du gsungs te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ me yi rang bzhin tsha ba dang*/ /bu ram rang bzhin mngar ba ltar/ /de phyir chos rnams thams cad kyis/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gsung/ /zhes pa dang*/ yum las*/ gzugs ni gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong ngo zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel chung du'ang*/ rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir/ /stong pa nyid ni nyi shur 'dod/ /ces so/ /de'ang stong pas med par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ stong pa'i rang bzhin snang ba dang dbyer med pas/ stong pa la chos thams cad 'thad de/ 'phags pa klu'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ /gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de la phan tshun gcig gis gcig stong pa ka ba dang bum pa'i stong pa dang*/ mi ldan pa'i stong pa dngos po dang dngos med dang rang mtshan gyi stong pa ri bong gi rwa dang*/

rang bzhin gyis stong pa gzugs brnyan lta bu la sogs pa dbye ba mang yang*/ de thams cad rtog ge bas kun brtags pa tsam las/ 'dir ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad/ rig ngo na snang yang gshis ngo na ma grub pa/ ye stong mtha' las 'das pa'i stong par rtogs par bya ste/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ gang tshe chos rnams thams cad kun/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma skyes pa/ /nam mkha' lta bur dngos med pa/ /stong pa nyid ni dag pa yin/ /ces pa dang*/ dpung bzangs las/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /ngo bo med cing gnas med pa/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid du nges nas/ stong pa'i dbyings las 'khor ba 'byung ba dang*/ de nyid du lam sbyong ba dang*/ mthar phyin nas grol ba'i rang bzhin ji lta bu snyam pa'i lan du/ dang po sdom tshig gi chings bstan pa ni/ skye med skye ba'i cho 'phrul ngang nyid du/ /rang bzhin sgyu ma sbyang bya'i gzhi dang ni/ /ma dag sgyu ma sbyang bya'i dri ma dang*/ /thabs kyi sgyu ma sbyong byed gnyen po dang*/ /ye shes sgyu ma mthar phyin 'bras bu ste/ /rnam bzhi dpe yi sgyu mas gtan la phab/ /ces mdor bstan pa las/ mkhas pa dag ni dpes go bar byed pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin sgyu ma la sogs bzhi po dag gi dbyings de las 'khrul pa dang*/ 'khrul pa sbyong ba dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i gnas skabs bzhis rig par bya ba las/ dpe'i sgyu mas sngon du go don bzhag na/ de'i rjes su rang rang gis mtshan nyid nges pa'i phyir/ dpe nges pa'i bya ba yang*/ ji ltar rigs sngags las byung mig 'phrul te/ /shing bu rde 'u rta glang snang dus nas/ /rta glang ma yin shing bu rde'u nyid/ /de bzhin tshes kun bde med mtshon pa nyid/ /rang bzhin dpe yis sgyu mar shes bya ste/ /'khrul pa'i gzhi dang 'khrul skyon 'khrul pa'i

tshul/ /'khrul snang 'khrul grol gdod mar grol tshul rnams/ /dpe yi sngon rol dpe dang dper 'grub dang*/ /dper grub dpe zhig sngon bzhin rang mtshan dus/ /rnam bzhi go rims dpe yis sgyu ma bstan/ /de la 'khrul gzhi'i rig pa ni rang bzhin sgyu ma ste/ 'khrul pa dngos su med la/ de'i steng na lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa yod pas 'khrul pa 'byung rung du yod pa ni/ rta glang snang rung du med la 'byung rung du yod sgyu ma mkhan bzang pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ las kyis sprul pa'i sgyu ma ni/ /'gro ba rigs drug 'di dag go /rkyen gyis sprul pa'i sgyu ma ni/ /me long gzugs brnyan la sogs so/ /chos kyis sprul pa'i sgyu ma ni/ /nga yi 'khor gyi dge slong ngo*/ /nga ni yang dag sgyu ma ste/ /'dus ma byas pa chos kyi sku/ /zhes gsungs so/ / pa dpe'i sngon rol gyi shing bu lta bu'o/ /rig pa dbyings las gzhir snang du 'phags pa'i tshe kun brtags pa'i ma rig pa gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa bar shar bas ma dag pa'i sgyu ma sbyang bya'i dri mar chags te/ rig pa la 'khrul rtog gi sbags pas/ 'khrul snang dngos su med la 'khrul rtog tu ldan pa/ rig sngags kyi sngags bgrangs bzhin pa lta bu ste/ rta glang gi dpe grub nges su byas pa lta bu'o/ /de nas rig ngor 'khrul snang dngos su snang dus 'di nyid rig pa gzung 'dzin gyis bslad pas sna tshogs rang snang du shar ba rig sngags las shing bu rde'u nyid rta glang gi rnam par snang ba'i rang dus sgyu ma dngos kyi dper grub pa lta bu'o/ /de nas rig pa la lam bsgoms pas bden zhen srab pa ni thabs sgyu ma ste/ sgyu ma'i rig sngags 'jig bzhin pa lta bu'o/ /de'i mthar 'khrul rtog log pas 'khrul snang 'gag ste gdod mar grol ba ni/ rig pa dang po'i gshis thog tu rang phebs pa'i dus de ye shes sgyu ma yin la ma rig gzung 'dzin gyi rig sngags log pas/

'khor ba 'khrul snang gi rta glang g-i snang ba log ste/ sgyu ma zhig pa'i shing bu rde'u ltar rig pa gzhi'i gzugs zang ka mar rang ngor snang bas sku dang ye shes 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dgongs pa las 'gyur ba med pa ni/ dpe zhig pa'i rang dus shing bu rde'u lta bu'o/ /'di dag ni rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig rlabs po che'i dka' ba'i gnas mngon du phyung ba'o/ / de ltar sgyu ma bzhi'i dpe don shan sbyar nas/ da ni so so'i mtshan nyid*/ gsal bar bshad pa las/ dang po/ rang bzhin sgyu ma sems nyid 'od gsal te/ /sbyang gzhi'i dbyings yin bde gshegs snying po yin/ /de la rig pa byang chub kyi sems 'di nyid/ ye nas lhun grub 'dus ma byas su gnas te/ 'khor 'das kun la dbri bsnan dang che chung med par khyab pa ni/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /ces pa dang/ rgyud bla ma las/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*/ /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*/ /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /ces so/ /de nyid ye nas dri ma med pa'i 'od gsal ba ste/ brgyad stong pa las/ sems la sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o zhes pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sang rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces pa dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /dri ma rnams ni glo bur nyid/ /ces so/ /de'ang khams bde bar gshegs pa' snying po de nyid/ sems can pa'i dus na ma dag pa'i khams/ byang chub saims dpa'i dus na ma dag dag pa'i khams/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus na shin tu rnam dag gi khams zhes ming gsum btags kyang*/ ngo bo la bzang ngan du 'gyur ba med de/ rgyud bla ma las/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang*/ / shin tu rnam dag go rims bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang*/

/de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes pa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de bzhin nyid de thams cad la/ khyad par med de dag gyur la/ /zhes pa dang*/ ji ltar sngon bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i de bzhin nyid/ /ces so/ /de lta bu'i khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po rang rig gi ngo bo la/ dag dang ma dag gang du'ang ma chad pas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa gnyis las 'das/ /'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dbyings yin 'char gzhi ste/ /rig dang ma rig rkyen las de ltar yin/ /'di ni gdod ma'i gshis yin gnas lugs yin/ /de la rig par rang gi ngo bo ni/ gang du'ang grub bsal med pas 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma grub ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'od srungs/ de la rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i dbyings de ni 'khor ba'ang ma yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang ma yin te dngos po med pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /gshis cir yang ma grub pa'i ngang las/ gdangs 'char gzhi ma 'gags pa'i rtsal gyis/ rig na myang 'das dang*/ ma rig pas 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang sgyu ma ltar snang ste/ do ha las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /zhes so/ /gang du'ang ma grub pas gang ltar yang 'char gzhi byed pa'i dpe nye bar dgod pa ni/ me long dngas bzhin gzugs brnyan 'char gzhi byed/ /shar dus nyid nas gang du'ang ma chad pa/ /me long ngos te dkar nag gnyis med la/ /dkar nag gnyis ka'i 'char gzhi byed dang mtshungs/ /'di nyid shes pas kun la mkhas par gyur/ /me long g.ya' dag pa'i ngos de gzugs brnyan gang du'ang ma grub la/ gang ltar yang 'char ba'i gzhi byed pa ste/ dkar nag tu shar yang dkar nag tu ma grub pa'i dpes rig pa me long dngas pa lta bu de yang gang du'ang ma grub la/ gang ltar 'char ba'i gzhi la/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba shar dus nyid nas/ rig pa la ma gos pa'i tshul 'di shes par bya'o/ /'dis ni snang yang 'dzin pas ched du ma bslad na 'khrul snang gis gos mi srid pa zhes bya ste/

yul spang len las 'das pas rig pa'i rang 'gros la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po zhes bya ba yin no/ / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ti lo pa'i zhal snga nas/ snang bas mi 'ching zhen pas 'ching*/ /zhen pa chod cig na ro pa/ /zhes pa dang*/ zhi ba lha'i zhal snga nas kyang*/ 'dir ni mthong thos shes pa dag /dgag par bya ba ma yin te/ / gang la'ang sdug bsngal rgyur gyur pa/ /bden par rtogs pa bzlog bya yin/ /zhes gsungs pa lta

bu'o/ /gnyis pa dag bya'i rang bzhin/ ma dag sgyu ma 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang ste/ /gnyis med gnyis su bzung las der snang ngo*/ / snod bcud 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'khrul rtog dang bcas pa 'di rnams rig pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i khams la sgrib pa'i dri ma ste/ rgyu kun 'byung las 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa snang ba yin no/ /gsum pa de dag sbyang ba ni/ thabs kyi sgyu ma gnyen po lam yin te/ tshogs dang sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam bzhi ru/ / tshogs gnyis rim gnyis sbyong byed bsgoms pa yis/ /sbyang bya'i dri ma sprin 'dra sel byed yin/ /de la tshogs lam chung ngur dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang*/ 'bring du yang dag spong ba bzhi dang*/ chen po rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang*/ /sbyor lam drod dang rtse mor dbang po lnga dang*/ bzod pa dang chos mchog tu stobs lnga dang*/ mthong lam du byang chub kyi lam yan lag bdun dang*/ sgom lam du 'phags pa'i lam brgyad de/ byang chub kyi chos sum bcu rtsa bdun dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis dang*/ bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis la gnas pa dang*/ lam gyi de kho na nyid gang du bgrod par 'gyur ro/ /de la sa lam gyi rim pa rab tu gces pas che long zhig brjod na/ mdo'i cha nas ji lta ba bzhin no/ /blo gros rab brtan gyi mdo las/ blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi ji ltar bsgom par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rab brtan/ gang de la byang chub sems dpa' lus kyi rjes su blta ba'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams bsgom ste/ gang zhe na/ lus sngon gyi mtha' dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha' dang*/ da ltar byung ba so sor brtag ste/ kye ma lus 'di rgyu dang rkyen las skyes ba mi rtag cing 'gyur ba sgyu ma lta bu ste/ lus 'di nga yir mi bya dang*/ lus snying po med pa la snying po blang bar bya ste/

snying po gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsgrub cing thob par bya'o/ /de ni lus kyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /blo gros rab brtan/ tshor ba la tshor ba'i rjes su blta ba'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gang zhe na/ tshor ba gang ci yang rung ste/ bde ba'i tshor ba la dga' bar byed/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba la zhe sdang bar byed/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i tshor ba la rmongs par byed/ bdag gi tshor ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rang bzhin med pa sbyangs la sems can thams cad kyi tshor ba rgyun bcad pa'i phyir chos bstan par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir na/ rtogs pa'i tshor ba ni bde ba/ ma rtogs pa'i tshor ba ni sdug bsngal bar 'gyur bas na/ dmigs pa dang yid la byed pa thams cad dang*/ ji srid chos su btags pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa ni tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /blo gros rab bstan/ sems la sems kyis rjes su blta ba'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gang zhe na/ sems ni skyes nas 'jig cing mi rtogs pas/ bdag gis thog mar sems bskyed cing/ gnas de yang zad cing gang na yang mi gnas pas sems kyis sems mi mthong ngo*/ /de la sems kyi mtshan nyid ni sgyu ma dang 'dra ste/ mtshan nyid med pa dang bral bar gnas pa bya'o/ /de ni sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /blo gros rab brtan/ chos la chos kyis rjes su blta ba'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gang zhe na gang stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa ma gtogs pa'i chos su grub pa rdul tsam yang mi dmigs te/ chos de la blta zhing gnas pa ni chos nyid yang dag pa mthong gi /chos su ma yin par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo*/ /de la dran pa nye bar gzhag pa zhes bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas ji snyed chos su btags pa thams cad ming tsam/ ming de dang chos de dag phyi nang gang du'ang mi rnyed pas/ mtha' mi rnyed cing mtha' med cing ma grub pas ni chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/

/blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol pa/ yang dag pa spong ba bzhi ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rab brtan/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam gang zhe na/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad pa byed/ brtson 'grus brtsam/ sems rab tu 'dzin/ yang dag par rab tu 'jog go /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad par byed/ brtson 'grus brtsam/ sems rab tu 'dzin/ yang dag par 'jog go /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad par byed/ brtson 'grus brtsam/ sems rab tu 'dzin/ yang dag par rab tu 'jog go /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ bskyed pa rnams gnas pa dang*/ gnas pa phyir zhing 'phel ba dang*/ nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ chud mi za ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad par byed/ brtson 'grus brtsam/ sems rab tu 'dzin yang dag par rab tu 'jog go / blo gros rab bstan/ gang sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams zhes bya ba ni/ tshul khrims dang/ teng nge 'dzin dang/ shes rab kyi mi 'thun pa'i phyogs so/ /tshul khrims kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni/ tshul khrims nyams pa dang/ tshul khrims nyams par 'gyur ba'i chos rnams so/ /teng nge 'dzin gyi mi 'thun pa'i phyogs ni/ sems g.yeng bar byed cing teng nge 'dzin nyams par byed pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs ni/ lta ba nyams pa dang*/ lta ba la mchog tu 'dzin pas yang dag par sgrib pa'i chos rnams so/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa ni/ mi dge ba'i chos spang pa'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad par byed/ brtson 'grus brtsam/ sems rab tu 'dzin/ yang dag par 'jog pa ni yang dag par spang ba dang po'o/ /gang yang mi dge ba'i chos rnams zhes bya ba ni/ 'dod pas chags/ khong khros sdang*/ ma rig pas rmongs te/

rgyu gang las byung zhes pa'o/ /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa ni mi gtsang bas 'dod chags dang*/ byams pas zhe sdang dang*/ rten 'brel gyis gti mug zhi bar byed do/ /gang nyon mongs pa de dag tha dad du rtogs pas spong zhes bya yis/ gang spong ba de ni rnyed par mi 'gyur bas yang dag pa spong ba gnyis pa'o/ /gang dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyes pa'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed/ 'bad par byed/ brtson 'grus brtsam/ sems yang dag par 'jog ces bya ba ni/ bsgrub par bya ba'i chos dge ba tshad med pa la 'dun pa dang*/ sems rab tu 'dzin pas nyams su len par byed pa ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste/ yang dag par spong ba gsum pa'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams gnas pa dang*/ nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang/ chud mi za bar bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang yang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad khams gsum la mi gnas par thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bsngos pas/ de la zad par 'gyur ba gang yang med pas yang dag par spong ba bzhi pa'o/ /blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rab brtan/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam ni bzhi ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spang ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang*/ sems kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang/ spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /blo gros rab bstan de la chos thams cad ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ gang du'ang mi dmigs shing 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i chos thams cad la mi sngangs dngangs par mi 'gyur dga' ba dang spro ba dang 'dun par byed pa de ni 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/

/ blo gros rab brtan/ gang dad pa rtse gcig pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pa des 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyi brtson pa 'dor zhing le lor gyur pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs par brtson 'grus rtsom pa de ni brtson 'grus kyi teng nge 'dzin to/ /blo gros rab brtan/ gang rtsol ba'i rtsom pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang ldan pa des sems gang du'ang mi dmigs/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de la rtse gcig pa ni sems kyi teng nge 'dzin to/ /blo gros rab bstan/ gang rtse gcig tu gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa des 'gro ba dang 'chag pa dang/ 'dug pa dang/ nyal ba'i dus thams cad du'ang ting nge 'dzin de las mi 'da' bas spyod pa ni spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /blo gros rab bstan/ de la ci'i phy-ir rdzun 'khrul gyi rkang pa zhes bya zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin des log par 'gyur ba'i chos thams cad spong bar byed/ spangs bas dge bar byed de/ yang dag pa'i gnas su phyin par byed/ bgrod par byaid pas na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa zhes bya'o/ /blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dbang po lnga gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rab brtan byang chub sems dpa'i lam la lnga ste/ lnga gang zhe na/ dad pa'i dbang po dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang*/ dran pa'i dbang po dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang*/ shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /de la dad pa'i dbang po gang zhe na/ 'khor ba na spyod pa 'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba la mngon par dad pa ste/ las kyi rnam par smin pa la 'jigs pas srog gi phyir yang sdig pa mi byed pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la zhugs pa dang*/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thos na the tshom med par dga' zhing dad pa ni dad pa'i dbang po'o/

/brtson 'grus kyi dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang la brtson 'grus kyi dbang po skyed par byed de/ de ni brtson 'grus kyi dbang po'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang la brtson 'grus kyis bsdus pa de dag dran pa'i dbang pos chud mi za bar byed pa de ni dran pa'i dbang po'o/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang dran pa'i dbang pos chud mi za bar byas pa de dag ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos rtse gcig tu ma yengs par byed pa de ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po gang zhe na/ chos gang ting nge 'dzin gyis rtse gcig tu byed pa de dag shes rab kyi dbang pos brtags pas/ chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar yongs su ma grub par shes pa de ni shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /blo gros rab brtan gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das stobs lnga gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ blo gros rab brtan/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam lnga ste/ dad pa'i stobs dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang*/ dran pa'i stobs dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang*/ shes rab kyi stobs so/ /dad pa'i stobs gang zhe na*/ gang la dad cing mos pa de la gang gis kyang mi brdzi ba ste/ de'i drung du bdud kyis sangs rgyas su bsgyur nas 'ong ste/ khyod kyi de ni chos ma yin no zhes sgyur bar byed/ log par byed kyang 'bral bar mi byed do/ /dbye bar mi byed do/ /de yang 'byung ba chen po rnams gzhan du 'gyur yang srid kyi/ dad pa'i stobs la mos pa de ni stobs de las 'bral bar mi nus pas na dad pa'i stobs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs gang zhe na/ gang brtson 'grus rtsom zhing dge ba'i chos gang dang gang la bstan pa'i stobs kyang*/ /gnas der ma phyin gyi bar du brtson pa'i stobs de sus kyang bzlog par mi nus pas brtson 'grus kyi stobs so/ /dran pa'i stobs gang zhe na/ chos gang dang gang la dran pa nye bar gzhag pas sems mi g.yeng ste/

de la nyon mongs pa gang gis kyang brdzi bar mi nus shing*/ dran pa'i stobs des nyon mongs pa 'joms pas dran pa'i stobs zhes bya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis stobs gang zhe na/ dran pa dang bag chags yod pas nyon mongs pas mi brdzi ba de nyid gang du gnas kyang 'du 'dzi las dben pa ste/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul thams cad la 'dzin pa'i 'du shes ma zhugs shing*/ chos gang la'ang rnam par mi rtog ste/ 'du 'dzi las dben pa'i stobs thob pas na ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs zhes bya'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs gang zhe na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad shes rab kyi stobs des yongs su shes nas/ 'jig rten pa rnams 'khor ba las sgrol ba ni/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi stobs las byung bas na shes rab kyi stobs zhes bya'o/ /de la ci'i phyir stobs lnga zhes bya zhe na/ dbang po lnga bstan zhing de'i stobs rgyas pas na stobs lnga zhe bya'o zhes pa dang*/ blo gros 'byung gnas kyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros 'byung gnas kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi lam yan lag bdun pa ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ blo gros 'byung gnas gang dran pa med cing yid la bya ba med pa'i phyir chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong ste/ gang de la chos thams cad ngo bo ma grub par mthong ba de ni dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go /blo gros 'byung gnas gang gi dge ba dang mi dge ba dang*/ /lung du ma bstan pa yang ma grub pa'i phyir/ chos su rtogs pa thams cad gang du'ang mi dmigs te/ sgyu ma lta bu ni chos rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag go /blo gros 'byung gnas/ gang gi chos thams cad 'du shes shin tu bshig pa'i phyir khams gsum mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad mi len mi 'dor bas lam gyi mngon par rtogs pa 'dzin pa dang bral ba la/

spro ba dang mi rtog pa'i mos pas brtson pa mi 'dor ba 'di ni/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go /gang dga' ba dang mi dga' ba thams cad bshig pa'i phyir/ 'du byed kyi chos thams cad la dga' ba mi bskyed par kun nas nyon mongs pa sel ba ni dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go /blo gros 'byung gnas/ gang gi dmigs par 'gyur ba'i chos thams cad rdul tsam yang mi dmigs pa'i phyir chos thams cad la lus shin tu sbyong ba dang*/ sems shin tu sbyangs pas sgrib pa med pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sems gnas pa ni/ shin tu sbyang pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go /blo gros 'byung gnas/ gang gi chos thams cad kyi 'dzin pa rnam par bshig pa'i phyir ram/ rtogs pa'i phyir sems ni gang la yang mi dmigs te/ gang sems mnyam par gzhag cing chos thams cad rtog par 'gyur gyi/ sems mnyam par gzhag pa ma yin dang/ sems mnyam par gzhag pas 'tshang rgya yis/ mnyam par ma bzhag pas ma yin no/ /de ltar 'dzin pa dang bral bar mnyam par 'jog pa de ni/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go /blo gros 'byung gnas/ gang gis chos thams cad gang la yang gnas par mi byed/ rten par mi byed/ chags par mi byed/ 'ching par mi byed/ gang la yang yid mi bde zhing sdug bsngal mang ba la sogs pa'i chos thams cad la sems mi 'dzin te/ 'jig rten gyis sems mi 'phrogs shing*/ des chos thams cad yang dag par rjes su mthong ba'i btang snyoms can du gyur nas dga' ba thob pa 'di ni/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go /blo gros 'byung gnas/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la de ltar blta bar bya'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i lam yan lag brgyad ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ blo gros 'byung gnas de la chos thams cad mnyam pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ste/

de la bdag tu lta ba dang*/ gang zag dang*/ sems can dang*/ srog dang*/ stong pa nyid du blta ba dang*/ lta ba yang dag pa mi byed do/ /de la lta ba'i dmigs pa chung ngu nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar dang*/ gang yang rab 'bring tha ma'i lta bar gyur pa thams cad dang bral ba ni yang dag pa'i lta ba'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la rtog pa gang gis rtogs pa spangs par 'gyur ba de yang zhi gnas kyis bsdus pa'i lhag mthong la mkhas te/ de la chos bzang ngan du rtogs pa dang/ yongs su rtog pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad spang ba ste/ cir yang mi rtog rnam par mi rtog /yongs su mi rtog pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i rtog pa'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la tshig gis bdag gzhan thams cad la mi gnod de/ de la bdag kyang nyon mongs par mi byed/ gzhan yang nyon mongs par mi byed tshig gang gis chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du nges par ston par byed pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i ngag go /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la las gang zad cing ma grub pa ni las kyi mtha'o/ /de las nyon mongs pa zhi bar 'gyur gyi/ nyon mongs pa 'bar ba'i phyir ma yin pa dang*/ las gang nyon mongs pa dang 'bral bar 'gyur gyi/ nyon mongs pa bskyed pa'i phyir ma yin pa ste/ dkar ba dang*/ gnag pa dang/ 'dres pa'i las kyi mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing*/ ma grub pa ni yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la nyon mongs pas mi gos pa ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ste/ de la 'tsho ba gang bdag la mi gnod/ gzhan la yang mi gnod par chos kyi don rjogs par 'gyur ba 'di ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la zab cing spros pa dang bral ba 'dus ma byas pa'i chos bsgrub pa ni yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ste/ de phyir sems rab tu 'dzin pa dang*/ 'dun pa dang*/ brtson pa dang*/ mi zhum pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i don mngon du byed pa ni yang dag pa'i rtsol ba'o/

/blo gros 'byung gnas/ de la dran pa gang gis nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis go skabs mi rnyed pa'o/ /de la byang chub kyi yan lag sems dang tshad med pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi dran pa ste/ dran pa gang gis bdud kyis skabs mi rnyed pa dang*/ dran pa gang gis lam log par mi 'gyur ba dang*/ dran pa sgo ba lta bu'i sems dang sems byung gi mos pa mi dge ba thams cad kyis skabs mi rnyed pa 'di niyang dag pa'i dran pa'o/ /blo gros 'byung gnas bdag mnyam pa nyid pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid dang*/ bdag rnam par dag pas chos thams cad rnam par dag pa dang*/ bdag stong pa nyid pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du yang dag par snyoms par 'jug la/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang gi sems skad cig dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /blo gros 'byung gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam yan lag brgyad de de ltar blta bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar lam gyi chos thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu ste/ khri brgyad stong pa las/ lha'i bu dag dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba rnams dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang*/ dbang po rnams dang/ stobs rnams dang*/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa rnams kyang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang*/ byams pa chen po dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes so/ /de la lam gyi ngo bo ni zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi thabs dang rtogs pa khyad par can yin te/ sgrib pa'i gnyen po dam pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms pa shes bya ste/ /zhes pa dang*/ bshes spring las/ bsam gtan med pa la yang shes rab med/ /shes rab med la yang bsam gtan med/ /gang la gnyis po yod pa srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho gnag rjes lta bur 'tshal bar bgyi/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /de yang tshogs sbyor na mos pas spyod pa'i sa de/ don dam pa'i bden pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyis stong nyid mos pas 'jal zhing*/ dbang po'i sgo bsdam pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gtso ba dang*/ nam gyi cha stod dang cha smad la mi nyal bar brtson pas/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi don bsgom zhing*/ thabs shes rab zung 'brel khyad par can la slob pas/ dang po tshogs lam gsum rdzogs pa'i rjes la/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye ba'i snga ltas su de dang mthun pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes te/ drod ces brjod pa dang*/ rtse mo dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ chos kyi mchog rnams rdzogs pa las/ nyon mongs par rags pa mgo non zhing 'phags pa'i ye shes dang po skye ba la dngos su phyogs pa'o/ /de nas mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bden pa bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum mthong ste khams kyi phyogs gcig spangs bya kun brtags glo bur ba dag pa'i dus so/ /de la sdug bsngal kun 'byung*/ lam 'gog pa'i bden pa re re bzhin chos shes pa dang*/ chos shes pa la bzod pa rjes su shes pa dang*/ rjes su shes pa la bzod pa ste/ bzhi bzhi bsdom pas bcu drug go /chos shes pa ni bden bzhi so so'i chos can gyi rang mtshan mthong ba'o/ /chos shes pa la bzod pa ni rang mtshan mthong bas mi skrag pa'o/ /rjes su shes pa ni bden bzhi so so'i chos nyid kyi rang mtshan stong nyid du mthong ba'o/ /rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa nam mkha' mthong ba la mi skrag pa'o/ /de dag blo rdzas gcig gis bden bzhi rang bzhin snang stong sgyu ma lta bur bya rdzogs kyi skad cig la mthong tshul bzhi bzhir 'char te/

bden bzhi don la chos shes bzhi/ chos bzod bzhi/ rjes shes bzhi/ rjes bzod bzhi'i rim pa so sor 'char ba'i phyir ro/ /de dag la mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ /chos shes rjes su shes pa dang*/ /bzod shes skad cig bdag nyid 'di/ /zhes so/ / de'i dus su mthong spang brgya dang bcu gnyis spang tshul ni/ kun brtags kyi nyon mongs pa drug la/ ma rig pa/ 'dod chags/ khong khro /nga rgyal/ the tshom/ lta ba'o/ /lta ba la lnga ste/ 'jig tshogs kyi lta ba/ mthar 'dzin/ log lta/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs la mchog 'dzin/ lta ba la mchog tu 'dzin pa'o/ /de la ma rig pa la sogs pa lta ba ma yin pa lnga po de dang bsdoms pas bcu/ de ltar rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa bcu po de 'dod khams na bden bzhi re re la bcu bcu byung bas bzhi bcu/ gzugs dang gzugs med gnyis na khong khro ma gtogs pa dgu dgu bden bzhi re re ma byung bas/ sum cu rtsa drug pa gnyis te bsdoms pas mthong spangs brgya dang bcu gnyis po spang tshul ni/ mthong lam gyi ye shes skye 'gyur lam gyis rags pa brgyud nas spangs/ skye bzhin pas phra ba dngos su spangs/ skyes dus nas mthong spangs kyi sa bon ma lus pa 'gag pa'i tshul gyis so/ /de'i 'og tu sgom lam sa dgu'i dri ma bzhi brgya dang bcu bzhi yang rang rang gi sa'i sbyor ba dang*/ dngos dang rjes la spang ste/ sgom spang gi nyon mongs pa bag la nyal ba'i lhan skyes las phyi na drug ste/ ma rig pa/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ 'jig tshogs su lta ba/ mthar 'dzin gyi lta ba'o/ /'dod khams na nyon mongs pa drug po rnams re re la'ang/ chen po/ 'bring/ chung ngu gsum gsum las/ de la'ang chen po'i chen po/ 'bring chung ngu/ 'bring gi chen po/ 'bring chung ngu/ chung ngu'i chen po 'bring*/ chung ngu ste/ dgu dgur phye bas drug tshan dgu ste lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ gzugs khams na bsam gtan dang po/

gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa rnams su khong khro bor nas nyon mongs pa lnga po rnams la che 'bring dgu dgu ste/ 'dod chags la sogs pa bzhi bcu zhe lnga pa lnga bsdoms pa'i brgya brgyad bcu/ gzugs med nam mkha'/ rnam shes/ ci yang med pa/ srid rtse bzhi la brgya brgyad cu ste/ khams gong ma'i brgya brgyad cu tshan gnyis la sum brgya drug cu/ de'i steng du 'dod pa'i lnga bcu rtsa bzhi bsnan pas sgom spang bzhi brgya dang bcu bzhi'o/ spang tshul yang*/ sbyor ba dang bar chad med lam gnyis kyis nye rgyu dang por spong*/ khyad par lam gyis dngos su spong*/ rnam grol gyis thag bsring dang phra ba 'gag 'gyur gyi tshul gyis spong ngo*/ /de yang sa rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa bcu la sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu gtso bo la lhag ma dgu 'khor du yod de/ dbus mtha' las/ khyad par can dang khyad med ni/ /sa bcu dag tu shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /sa bcu'i yon tan yang*/ khye'u rab snang gi mdo las/ rigs kyi bu de la byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang po la gnas pa'i ltas ni/ 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la ting nge 'dzin brgya rab tu thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas brgya mthong ba de dag gis byin gyis brlabs par yang shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya bskyod pa dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgyar snang bar byed pa dang*/ sems can brgya yongs su smin par byed pa dang*/ bskal pa brgya gnas par byed pa dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa brgya dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal ba brgya la 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo brgya rnam par 'byed pa dang*/ lus brgya yongs su ston pa dang*/ lus re re la'ang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor brgya brgya yang dag pa'i btson 'grus rtsom zhing yon tan de snyed dang ldan pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu sa gnyis pa la gnas pa ni skad gcig yud tsam thang cig la ting nge 'dzin stong thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/

sangs rgyas stong mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten khams stong bskyod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong du 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi zhing stong snang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can stong yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ bskal pa stong du gnas par bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa stong dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa stong la 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo stong rab tu 'byed pa dang*/ lus stong yongs su ston pa dang*/ lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor stong stong yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa gsum pa la gnas pa ni/ skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ ting nge 'dzin brgya stong rab tu 'thob bo/ /sangs rgyas brgya stong mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong rab tu bskyod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong du 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong snang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can brgya stong yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ bskal pa brgya stong du gnas par bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa brgya stong dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa brgya stong du snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo brgya stong rab tu 'byed pa dang*/ /lus brgya stong yongs su ston pa dang*/ lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor brgya stong yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa bzhi pa la gnas pas/ skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ ting nge 'dzin khrag khrig thob cing snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas khrag khrig mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig bskyod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khrag khrig tu 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig snang bar bya ba dang*/

sems can khrag khrig yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ bskal pa khrag khrig tu gnas par bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig tu 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo khrag khrig tu 'byed pa dang*/ lus khrag khrig tu yongs su ston pa dang*/ lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor khrag khrig yang dag par ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa lnga pa la gnas pas skad cig yun tsam thang cig la/ ting nge 'dzin khrag khrig stong thob cing de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas khrag khrig stong mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig stongabaskyod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams khrag khrig stong du 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig stong snang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can khrag khrig stong smin par bya ba dang*/ bskal pa khrag khrig stong du gnas par bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig stong dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig stong du 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo khrag khrig stong 'byed pa dang*/ lus khrag khrig stong yongs su ston pa dang*/ lus re re la byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor khrag khrig stong yongs su rab tu ston to/ /

rigs kyi bu sa drug pa la gnas pas 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ ting nge 'dzin khrag khrig brgya stong thob cing de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas khrag khrig brgya stong mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams khrag khrig brgya stong bskyod pa dang*/ sems can khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong du gnas par bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa khrag khrig brgya stong du 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo khrag khrig brgya stong 'byed pa dang*/ lus khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su ston pa dang*/ lus re re la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor khrag khrig brgya stong yang dag yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa bdun pa la gnas pas 'dod pa na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ ting nge 'dzin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong thob cing de la snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong rab tu bskyod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams de snyed snang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can de snyed yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ bskal pa de snyed du gnas par bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa de snyed dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa ji snyed du 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo de nyid 'byed pa dang*/ lus de snyed ston pa dang*/ lus re re la byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong yang dag par ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa brgyad pa la gnas par 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/ stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rabs snyed thob pa de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/

sangs rgyas brgya stong sum brgya drug cu'i rdul phra rabs snyed mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs par yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong sum brgya phrag bcu'i rdul phra rabs snyed du bskyod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams de snyed du 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams de snyed snang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can de snyed yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ bskal pa de snyed du gnas par bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa de snyed dang phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa de snyed du 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo de snyed 'byed pa dang*/ lus de snyed ston pa dang*/ lus re re la byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor stong sum brgya phrag bcu'i rdul phra rabs snyed yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa dgu pa la gnas par 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang gcig la/ ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams brgya stong grangs med phrag bcu'i rdul phra rabs snyed thob cing de dag la snyoms par 'jug pa dang/ sangs rgyas brgya stong grangs med phrag bcu'i rdul phra rabs snyed mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par rab tu shes pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong grangs med phrag bcu'i rdul phra rabs snyed du bskyod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams de snyed du 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams de snyed snang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can de snyed yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ bskal pa de snyed du gnas par bya ba dang*/ sngon gyi mtha'i bskal pa de snyed dang*/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa de snyed du 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo de snyed 'byed pa dang*/ lus de snyed ston pa dang*/ lus re re la byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor grangs med brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul phra rabs snyed yang dag par ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sa bcu pa la gnas par 'dod na skad cig yud tsam thang cig la/

chos kyi snang ba chen po dang*/ chos kyi 'od chen po dang*/ chos kyi sprin tshad med pa'i bzod pa thob bo/ yang dag par 'dzin to/ /yang dag par ston to/ /bdag gir mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nam mkha' lta bu'i chos kyi sku las ye shes chos kyi sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pas chos kyi sprin zhes bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /de la kha cig sa lam gyi yon tan 'di dag rmi lam spel bsgyur tsam la zer gyi nyin dus med de/ tshangs pa kun dga'i mdo las/ sa dang lam gyi yon tan rnams/ /rmi lam skabs las rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/ mdo de ni sa lam gang du bsgrod pa'i rmi lam khyad par can de gsungs pa dpe des sa thob par bstan gyi/ nyin dus yon tan med par bstan pa ma yin no/ /yon tan 'di dag nyin mtshan rtag par yod pa yin no/ /'di dag gi tshul rgyas par ni shing rta chen por bstan pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /thabs lam sgyu ma bstan zin to/ / da ni thabs des grub pa'i/ ye shes sgyu ma mthar phyin mi slob lam/ / rgyal ba'i sku gsum phrin las lhun grub ste/ /dag pa nyis ldan mngon du gyur pa yin/ /sa bcu rgyun gyi mtha' mar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas ngan len gyi dri ma mtha' dag bcom pa'i rjes la/ mngon par byang chub ste/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mthar phyin nas/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i chos sku dag pa nyis ldan gyi ngang las gzugs sku gnyis lhun grub tu snang bas 'khor ba ji srid bar don mdzad de/ ye shes bla na med pa'i rgyud las/ 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings nyid dang/ /ye shes gnyis su med pa ste/ /nyon mongs shes bya yang dag pa'i/ /chos sku dag pa nyis ldan te/ /mi 'gyur ma skyes mtshan med pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /de la bzhengs bzhugs mi mnga' yang*/ /sngon gyi sems bskyed bsod nams chos/

/smon lam bskyed rim rgyu rkyen las/ /gzugs sku gnyis ni rang shar 'byung*/ / zhes so/ /'dir thub pa mchog dang sbyar nas theg pa chung ngu bas so so'i skye bo rang rgyud pa gcig gi sku tshe de la lam lnga mngon du byas nas rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas par 'dod de/ mdzod las/ 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang*/ / nad pa dang ni chos smra dang*/ /skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpal la/ /yon ni gzhal du med par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /theg chen las/ mtshan nyid theg chen ni/ sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i dus su sangs rgyas zin cing*/ 'dir sems can gyi don du sangs rgya bar ston pa 'dod de/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ rigs kyi bu nga ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang po 'das pa'i sngon rol du sangs rgyas so zhes pa dang yab sras mjal ba las/ nga 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang dpag tu med pa 'das pa'i dus na/ sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog ces bya ba sangs rgyas so zhes so/ / gsang sngags rnal 'byor gyi lugs kyi rgyal bu don grub 'og min du byon pa dang*/ til gyi gong bu kha bye ba lta bu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs te mngon byang lngas sangs rgya bar 'dod do/ /rnal 'byor bla med rgyud las ni/ 'og min du rnam snang rdo rje 'chang chen po la dbang zhus nas der sangs rgyas pa'i sprul pa 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sangs rgya bar 'dod do/ /zla gsang thig le las/ gtsang ma'i rigs dag spangs pa yis/ /'og min stug po nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po zhig 'dir sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'dus pa don yod pa'i rgyud las/ gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'og min dam par ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mtsho chen dbang phyug des/ /chos kyi pho brang der ni dbang bskur bas/ /kun tu bzang po rdo rje dbyings kyi skur/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/

/de nyid du ni mngon par byang chub pas/ /bla med snying po'i rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ /rang byung bde ba chen por mngon sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /ma rgyud pa ni/ khrag chen gyi sangs rgyas bcu gcig de 'og min gyi gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i gzhal yas dbus su dbang bzhi rdzogs zhus nas bud med mchog la brten nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob bo/ /rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ bcu gcig sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang*/ /bud med phyag rgya brten byas nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob 'gyur/ /ces so/ /de dag kyang theg pa phyogs re'i cha tsam ste/ 'dir dpal gnyis su med pa'i rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po'i lugs kyis/ slob lam rdzogs pa'i rjes la/ khams kyi sgrib pa sprin dang 'dra ba mtha' dag spangs nas/ khams de dang byang chub ces yon tan ci yin pa sangs rgyas te/ sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pas don gnyis rdzogs par 'dod de/ sgyu 'phrul rgyas pa las/ dri med dag pa'i byang chub ni/ /'gyur ba med las dri bral ba/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i rang gzugs te/ /sku lnga ye shes lhun gyis grub/ /ces pa dang*/ gsang snying las/ de tshe sku lnga kun kyang rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /gang du'ang sangs rgyas pa'i 'og min de gang na yod ce na/ kha cig de gtsang ma ris kyi 'og min du 'dod pa yang mi 'thad de/ gtsang ma'i gnas dag spangs pas gnod do/ kha cig gtsang ma'i 'og min las grong las dgon pa'i tshod tsam zhes pa'ang mi 'thad de/ phyogs dang rgya khyon tshad med pa'i/ /zhes pas gnod do/ /'dir ni thog ma sangs rgyas pa'i rang snang dag pa de rig pa'i 'og min yin pas sku dang ye shes dbyings gcig tu brnyes pa der bshad de/ ye shes bla na med pa'i rgyu las/ sems nyid bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /'og min gtsang ma'i gnas mchog go /zhes pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las/ 'og min de nyid rnam mdzes pa/
